sloka: तातस्य प्रियकामेन यौवराज्यमपेक्षता ।लोकयोरुभयोः शक्यम् त्वया यत्सुखमेधितुम् ॥२-५२-३६॥
transliteration: tātasya priyakāmena yauvarājyamapekṣatā ।lokayorubhayoḥ śakyam tvayā yatsukhamedhitum ॥2-52-36॥

translations.english: Princeregency is awaiting you because of our father's loving desire. See that through you (your actions) he is able to attain happiness in both the worlds.
